title: Taweez against Headache & Ear ache
data:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) is reported to have said: Whoever suffers from headache may rub his head with his hand and repeat the following statement seven times:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ الَّذِىْ سَكَنَ لَهٗ مَا فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَ مَا فِى السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ.
AAA'UWDHU BII ALADHIAA SAKANA LAHU MAA FIAA ALBARI WAALBAHRI WA MAA FIAA ALSAMAAWAATI WAALAARDI WA HUWA ALSAMIYA'U ALA'ALIYMU.
May Allah accept this supplication.
اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا اَنَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاۤءِ كُلَّ شَيْئٍ حَيٍّ اَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ.
AAWALAM YARA ALADHIYNA KAFARUWA AANA ALSAMAAWAATI WAALAARDA KAANATAA RATQANA FAFATAQNAAHUMAA WA JAA'ALNAA MINA ALMAA'I KULA SHAY'IN HAYIN AAFALAA YU'MINUWNA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ اَنْ تَزُوْلَا وَ لَئِنْ زَالَتَا اِنْ اَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ بَعْدِهٖ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ حَلِيْمًا غَفُوْرًا.
AINA A YUMSIKU ALSAMAAWAATI WA ALAARDA AAN TAZUWLAA WA LA'IN ZAALATAA AIN AAMSAKAHUMAA MIN AAHADIN MIN BAA'DIHI AINAHU KAANA HALIYMANA GHAFUWRANA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
